messages:
nora: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp kept using the old PROJECT key after ops injected an ORG key into the pod env. Streams stayed authenticated as the old principal. Anyone seen SDKs prefer on-disk creds?
phil: Which SDK/version? How are you rotating envs?
nora: repro: container had ~/.redwood/credentials baked or created at startup with REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT=proj-old. Later k8s sidecar sets REDWOOD_API_KEY_ORG=org-new, but requests still show proj-old.
mika: old sdks favored the credentials file over env vars. If that file exists, client init won't re-read env on rotation.
phil: Quick mitigation: remove ~/.redwood/credentials in the container on startup when env keys present. Longer term: SDK should warn when env!=file and consider flipping precedence in 2.x.
nora: filing RFC/issue for env>file precedence + a one-line warning in 1.x so onboarding isn't surprising.
devex-bot: Created issue DEVEX-4800: "Credential precedence during env rotation (env vs cached file)" and linked repos.
phil: Assigning @mika for SDK warning PR and @nora for quickstart note. I'll add e2e rotation test to sampleapp CI.
mika: will open a small PR to log a warning and add docs.
